race.comment: BREWSTER BUCK (2) gets the nod after a solid last-start second at Gawler, finishing a length and a half back as a well-supported favourite. He made good ground from well back at Morphettville Parks previously, but the one-week turnaround is a slight concern. He should be peaking now and ready to show what he can do. OPAL HERITAGE (3) poses the main threat, resuming with a third at Morphettville Parks despite some trouble in the straight. Unknown over 1600m, but he has the right class. CATHAY EXPRESS (4) finished ahead of both BREWSTER BUCK and OPAL HERITAGE at Morphettville Parks, running on well for second from a less-favoured position. His first test at 1600m will be crucial. WILLEBOB (1) drops back from a metro meeting after a rough trip at Morphettville and he could improve into the placings if he can finish more cleanly.
